in_sanskrit.name: धृष्टद्युम्न
in_sanskrit.meaning: The one who sees the invincible
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: धृष्टः (dhrishta) - The Seer, द्युम्नः (dyumna) - The Radiant, धृष्टद्युम्नः (dhrishtadyumna) - The Seer of the Radiant

in_hindi.name: धृष्टद्युम्न
in_hindi.long_meaning: धृति (dhriti) - Firmness, Vāle (vale) - Possessor, अद्युम्न (adyumna) - Radiant, धृष्टद्युम्न (dhrishtadyumna) - Possessor of the Radiant Firmness

in_tamil.name: திருஷ்டத்தியும்ன
in_tamil.long_meaning: இறைவன் (iraiyan) - God, வாழ்விட்டு (vazhvittu) - Dwelt, இழித்த (izittu) - Slew, இயல் (iyal) - Power, வாழ்வான் (vazhvan) - Dweller, திருஷ்டத்தியும்ன (dhrishtadiyumna) - God who slew with power

in_telugu.name: ధృష్టద్యూమ్న
in_telugu.long_meaning: దృష్టే (dhrishte) - Seer, యోప (yopa) - Possessor, ఆదేశ్ (adhESha) - Lord, శ్వరో (swarO) - Supreme, ధృష్టద్యూమ్న (dhrishtadyumna) - Seer of the Supreme Lord

in_marathi.name: Dhrishtadyumna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhrishtadyumna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhrishta (Seer) + Dyumna (Skilled or Intelligent)

in_bengali.name: Dhrishtadyumna
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Skilled Seer
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dhrishtadyumna একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Dhrishta (Seer) + Dyumna (Skilled or Intelligent)
